description: Record a purchase outcome for a product (product_id or product_url). Requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer header). Proofs: shopify_order (shop domain, order number, confirmation number) is checked against the shop's order record; email_receipt (the merchant's original DKIM-signed confirmation email, order number, product name) is checked by its signature; both count when they match. payment_receipt is stored as quarantined.

order_number.description: Order number as it appears in the email.
order_number.title: Order Number

product_name.description: Product name exactly as it appears in the email.
product_name.title: Product Name

raw_email_base64.description: The merchant's original order confirmation email (.eml, RFC 5322), base64-encoded. Its DKIM signature is verified; the email is processed in memory and never stored.
raw_email_base64.title: Raw Email Base64

reference.description: Receipt or transaction reference. Hashed on arrival, never stored.
reference.title: Reference

confirmation_number.description: Order confirmation number from the order confirmation, e.g. XPLZ3K9HG. Never stored.
confirmation_number.title: Confirmation Number

order_number.description: Order number as shown to the buyer, e.g. #1001. Never stored.
order_number.title: Order Number

shop_domain.description: The store's domain, e.g. brand.com or brand.myshopify.com.
shop_domain.title: Shop Domain

name: submit_outcome
